whenToUse: Text fields with a leading icon, prefix or suffix text, a unit or a status mark inside one border
Search, link and API bars that end in a copy, clear, filter, menu or send control
Prompt and comment composers: a text area with a toolbar row above or below the text

whenNotToUse.when: Selects, fields and actions joined edge to edge, each keeping its own border
A plain text field with no icon, text or action inside its border
A complete assistant screen with a message thread above the prompt box

agentNotes: The border turns red from `aria-invalid` on the control; `data-invalid` on `Field` only tints text, so set both as `c-input-group-3` does
Addon icons and text never name the control; tie a `FieldLabel` to the input or textarea id as `c-input-group-20` does, or give it an aria label
`InputGroupButton` defaults `type` to button, so pass submit when it should send the surrounding form
